Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider

Class YamlStorageProvider

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider.YamlStorageProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueryableStorage, StorageProvider
public class YamlStorageProvider extends Object implements StorageProvider, QueryableStorage
Simple file-based YAML storage provider. Stores each path as a separate `.yml` file under the plugin data folder `storage/`.
